IC2: Hypertension - untreated  (Systolic Blood Pressure (SBP)  ≥ 140 mm Hg [OR] or Diastolic Blood Pressure (DBP) ≥ 90 mm Hg) [OR] or treated
IC4: Score ≤ 10 on the Short Physical Performance Battery [OR] OR Walking speed < 1.2 m/sec [AND] during 400 m usual-paced test
IC5: Sedentary lifestyle [OR], defined as <150 min/wk of moderate physical activity [AND] as assessed by CHAMPS questionnaire
IC6: Willingness to participate in all study procedures
